editorial:
Imagine having a perfect life with a big house and plenty of money, only to have your peace ruined by a ghost from your past. You follow Sung-soo, a man who seems to have it all until his long-lost brother vanishes. When he goes to his brother's creepy apartment to find out what happened, he realizes someone is hiding in the walls and watching him. The whole vibe is super tense, making you feel like you are being followed even in your own home. It starts as a family mystery but quickly turns into a scary game of cat and mouse that will keep you on the edge of your seat.

The acting is top-notch and the twists really catch you off guard. While the middle part slows down a bit, the payoff is totally worth it. If you love movies that make you lock your doors at night, you need to see this. For the best experience, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to catch all the small details in the shadows, or you can rent it on Apple TV for a movie night. It is a great pick for anyone who likes a good puzzle with a scary edge.
endingExplained: You find out that the mystery person is actually a group of people who live in the hidden spaces of apartment buildings. They break into homes and mess with people's lives for fun. In the end, Sung-soo discovers that his brother was killed by these intruders. After a scary fight in the walls, the truth comes out about the family's past. The movie ends with a chilling reminder that these hidden people could be anywhere, even in your own home.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological thrillers and home invasion stories.
